description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.7, §5.9, §5.10): Skarn Steading - Ulfra and the giants of her steading (members carry faction "skarn"; its three longhouses carry it on their nodes). Friendly and at peace: its giants watch and talk and never fight (their AI is off). Damage the giant does to Skarn's longhouses or its folk is an offence: two within 30 s turn the steading against the giant - Ulfra then only takes 2 iron for the harm (outcome reconcile_skarn). The siege of Skarn (event.siege_of_skarn) is the toll-riders' doing, not Skarn's quarrel with the giant.

reconcile.text: Pay for the harm you did to Skarn (2 iron)

warn_text: Skarn's giants rise from their benches. Strike their hall again and the steading turns from you.
hostile_text: Skarn's horn sounds: the steading turns from you.
reconciled_text: Ulfra takes your iron: Skarn's hall is open to you again.
